body.p: CPU Die contains the central compute cores and supporting infrastructure.

ul.li: CPU Die separate from the SoC die is "time to performance" - iterating CPU die is quicker than a monolithic SoC
Development is faster since IO's, Display, Graphics, etc. don't have to be debugged and tuned every time there's a new core and process.
CPU die process is tuned for the core.

body.p: Compute die is used in all SKU with difference in atom and P-cores numbers.
Refer to the EDS for SKUs planned number of Atom and P-cores. All other IPs remains same.
